description: This file defines a registry and management system for formatter classes used in the 'behave' testing framework, including registration, validation, loading, and instantiation of formatters.

classes.name: BadFormatterClass
classes.description: Placeholder class for invalid formatter classes, providing error detection and messaging.

methods.name: format_iter
methods.description: Returns an iterator over registered formatter names.

methods.name: format_items
methods.description: Ensures all formatter classes are loaded and valid, returning an iterator over registry items.

methods.name: register_as
methods.description: Registers a formatter class with a given name, handling lazy loading and validation.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a formatter class using its 'name' attribute.

methods.name: register_formats
methods.description: Registers multiple formatters from a list of (name, class) pairs.

methods.name: load_formatter_class
methods.description: Loads a formatter class from a module and class name string, handling errors.

methods.name: select_formatter_class
methods.description: Retrieves a formatter class by name, loading it if necessary.

methods.name: is_formatter_class_valid
methods.description: Checks if a class is a subclass of Formatter and a class object.

methods.name: is_formatter_valid
methods.description: Checks if a formatter name corresponds to a loadable and valid formatter class.

methods.name: make_formatters
methods.description: Creates formatter instances based on configuration and stream openers for use in behave.
